node.title: Re^3: Moo different parameters for constructor
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Also, How can we validate constructor args?

There's several different ways to do this. The code I showed already uses [dist://Type-Tiny], see its documentation on how to use it for tighter constraints, and see the documentation for isa in [mod://Moo]. I also mentioned [mod://MooX::StrictConstructor] above.
